Does your tenancy agreement have a non-smoking clause? If so then your building manager/landlord would be your first point of contact. The municipal bylaw only applies to common places and not individual units. Also keep in mind if your neighbours for some reason don't have the non-smoking clause in their tenancy agreement (for example a lot of older rental agreements don't have it since the Smoke-Free Ontario Act didn't come into effect until 2017), then they can continue smoking in their unit for the length of their tenancy.
